replies.author: cinammoncroc000
replies.body:
I understand the reasoning behind the design of this map, but it's... extremely small. And the little space that is available is covered by trees, meaning there's hardly any room to PvP.
I don't want to sound mean :c but I'm not a fan of this. It looks like it could be easily built too.

-1 :T

replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body: It seems too blocky and there's no tactical placement of the trees, the size makes this difficult to play. At most, I'd say this is a 2v2 (can only withstand 4 players). I would recommend expanding greatly and adding structure instead of the scattering as well as trying to aim for at least 16v16.
